# Design catalog

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:catalog` from @mariachi/design (dist/catalog.json). Do not edit. -->

36 components and 6 presets. How to use and override them: [design.md](./design.md).
Every component and preset is browsable in the [explorer](./explorer.md).

## Presets

| Preset | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `minimal` | Neutral greys, one blue accent, 6px radius and soft shadows. A safe default for product UI. |
| `brutalist` | No radius, thick borders, hard offset shadows, uppercase headings and a loud accent. |
| `editorial` | Serif headings, warm paper canvas, ink text with an ink-blue accent, hairline rules, no shadows and generous spacing. |
| `soft` | Pastel palette, pill-shaped controls, large rounded containers and diffuse shadows. |
| `enterprise` | Dense layout, compact type, small radii, crisp borders and strong table styling for data-heavy tools. |
| `terminal` | Monospace everywhere, outline borders, square corners, no shadows and a phosphor accent. Dark-first. |

## Layout

| Component | What it is | Use it when | Markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Card (`card`) | A surface that groups related content, with optional header, body and footer. | Grouping a unit of content: a summary, a settings group, a list item that links somewhere. | `.m-card` `.m-card-header` `.m-card-title` `.m-card-description` `.m-card-body` `.m-card-footer` `[data-variant]` `[data-size]` `[data-interactive]` |
| Divider (`divider`) | Horizontal or vertical rule, optionally with a centred label. | Separating groups of content or actions. Prefer spacing first; use a divider when groups still blur together. | `.m-divider` `[data-orientation="vertical"]` |
| Layout (`layout`) | Stack, cluster, grid, split and container primitives that space children with tokens. | Arranging any group of elements. Prefer these over ad-hoc margins. | `.m-stack` `.m-cluster` `.m-grid` `.m-split` `.m-container` `[data-gap]` `[data-align]` `[data-justify]` `[data-size] on .m-container` |

## Actions

| Component | What it is | Use it when | Markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Button (`button`) | Triggers an action. Four variants, three sizes, icon-only and loading states. | Any clickable action. Use a link (&lt;a class="m-button"&gt;) when it navigates. | `.m-button` `[data-variant]` `[data-size]` `[data-icon-only]` `[aria-busy="true"]` |

## Forms

| Component | What it is | Use it when | Markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Checkbox (`checkbox`) | Native checkbox drawn with tokens: checked, indeterminate, invalid and disabled states. | Independent on/off choices, or picking several items from a list. Use a switch for settings that apply immediately. | `.m-checkbox` `[aria-invalid="true"]` |
| Field (`field`) | Wraps a control with its label, hint, error and required marker; an inline layout serves checkbox, radio and switch rows. | Every form control. It keeps label, hint and error spacing consistent and lines up inline controls with their text. | `.m-field` `.m-field-label` `.m-field-hint` `.m-field-error` `[data-layout="inline"]` |
| Input (`input`) | Single-line text input and multi-line textarea, with sizes, invalid and disabled states. | Free-text entry. Wrap it in .m-field to give it a label, hint and error. | `.m-input` `[data-size]` `[aria-invalid="true"] / :user-invalid` |
| Radio (`radio`) | Native radio button drawn with tokens: checked, invalid and disabled states. | Choosing exactly one of two to five options that should all stay visible. Use a select for longer lists. | `.m-radio` `[aria-invalid="true"]` |
| Select (`select`) | Native &lt;select&gt; styled to match inputs, with a CSS-only chevron. | Choosing one option from a short, known list. Use radios for two to four options that should all stay visible. | `.m-select` `[data-size]` `[aria-invalid="true"] / :user-invalid` `[multiple]` |
| Switch (`switch`) | On/off toggle built on a native checkbox with role="switch". | A setting that takes effect immediately (enable notifications, dark mode). Use a checkbox for choices submitted with a form. | `.m-switch` `[data-size]` |

## Data display

| Component | What it is | Use it when | Markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Avatar (`avatar`) | A person or entity as an image or initials, in three sizes, with an overlapping group. | Showing who owns, wrote or is present on something. Pair with the name nearby when it matters. | `.m-avatar` `[data-size]` `.m-avatar-group` |
| Table (`table`) | Data table with header styling, row hover, striping, compact density, numeric columns and a scrolling wrapper. | Tabular data people compare across rows and columns. Use a list or cards for a handful of unrelated items. | `.m-table` `.m-table-wrap` `[data-striped]` `[data-density="compact"]` `[data-sticky]` |

## Navigation

| Component | What it is | Use it when | Markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Breadcrumb (`breadcrumb`) | The path from the site root to the current page. | Hierarchical pages more than two levels deep (docs, settings, file browsers). | `[aria-current="page"]` |
| Navbar (`navbar`) | The top bar of an app or site: brand, primary links and actions. Optionally sticky and translucent. | Primary, site-wide navigation with a handful of top-level destinations. | `.m-navbar` `.m-navbar-brand` `.m-navbar-nav` `.m-navbar-link` `.m-navbar-actions` `[data-sticky]` `[data-translucent]` |
| Pagination (`pagination`) | Links between pages of a long list, with previous/next and an ellipsis for skipped ranges. | Paged tables and lists where the user may jump to a page. Prefer "Load more" or cursor-based next/previous for feeds. | `.m-pagination-item` `[aria-disabled="true"]` `.m-pagination-ellipsis` |
| Sidebar (`sidebar`) | Vertical navigation with headed sections, collapsible groups, nested lists and counts. | Secondary navigation through many pages: docs, settings, an app with more destinations than fit in a navbar. | `.m-sidebar` `.m-sidebar-section` `.m-sidebar-heading` `.m-sidebar-group` `.m-sidebar-link` `.m-sidebar-count` `[data-sticky]` |
| Tabs (`tabs`) | Switches between panels of related content. Styled from ARIA state, so any script (or the optional behaviors) just toggles attributes. | Two to about seven peer views of the same object. Use links in a navbar when each view has its own URL. | `.m-tabs` `.m-tab-list` `.m-tab` `.m-tab-panel` `[data-variant] on .m-tabs` `[aria-disabled="true"] on .m-tab` |

## Feedback

| Component | What it is | Use it when | Markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Alert (`alert`) | An inline message about the page or a section: success, warning, error or information. | A message that stays on the page until the cause changes. Use a toast for transient confirmations. | `.m-alert` `.m-alert-icon` `.m-alert-content` `.m-alert-title` `.m-alert-body` `.m-alert-actions` `[data-tone]` |
| Badge (`badge`) | Short status label in six tones and three variants. | Labelling status, counts or categories (Beta, Failed, 3 new). Not for actions: use a button. | `.m-badge` `[data-tone]` `[data-variant]` |
| Progress and meter (`progress`) | Native &lt;progress&gt; for task completion (with an indeterminate state) and &lt;meter&gt; for a measurement within a range. | Progress: uploads, indexing, multi-step jobs. Meter: quota or capacity used, where high values can be good or bad. | `[data-size]` |
| Skeleton (`skeleton`) | Placeholder shapes with a shimmer, shown while content of a known shape loads. | Loading lists, cards or messages whose layout you know ahead of time. | `.m-skeleton` `[data-shape]` |
| Spinner (`spinner`) | An indeterminate loading ring for short waits where layout is not yet known. | Waiting on something that usually takes under a few seconds. Prefer a skeleton when you know the shape of the content. | `.m-spinner` `[data-size]` |
| Toast (`toast`) | Brief, non-blocking notifications stacked in a fixed live region. | Confirming something the user just did, or reporting a background event. Use an alert for messages that must stay on the page. | `.m-toast-region` `[data-position] on the region` `[data-static] on the region` `.m-toast` `[data-tone]` `.m-toast-content` `.m-toast-title` `.m-toast-body` `.m-toast-actions` `.m-toast-close` |

## Overlays

| Component | What it is | Use it when | Markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dialog (`dialog`) | A modal window on the native &lt;dialog&gt; element, with header, body, footer and an animated backdrop. | Focused tasks or confirmations that block the page until dismissed. Prefer inline UI when the user may need the page behind it. | `.m-dialog` `.m-dialog-header` `.m-dialog-title` `.m-dialog-description` `.m-dialog-body` `.m-dialog-footer` `[data-size]` `[data-static]` |
| Popover and menu (`popover`) | Floating panels on the native popover attribute, anchored to their trigger where CSS anchor positioning is supported, plus a menu inside them. | Menus of actions, small forms or extra details that open from a trigger. Use a dialog when the content needs the user's full attention. | `.m-popover` `[data-placement]` `[data-static]` `.m-menu` `.m-menu-item` `.m-menu-shortcut` `.m-menu-label` `.m-menu-separator` |
| Tooltip (`tooltip`) | A CSS-only text label shown above or below an element on hover and keyboard focus. | Naming icon-only buttons or giving a short hint. Never put essential information or interactive content in a tooltip. | `.m-tooltip` `[data-tip]` `[data-placement]` `[data-open]` |

## Content

| Component | What it is | Use it when | Markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Accordion (`accordion`) | Stacked disclosure sections on native &lt;details&gt;, joined in one box or separated, with an animated open where supported. | FAQs and long pages where readers scan headings and open only what they need. | `.m-accordion` `.m-accordion-item` `.m-accordion-content` `[data-variant]` |
| Code (`code`) | Code blocks and inline code. Blocks define the Shiki css-variables theme, so highlighted code takes its colours from the active preset. | Showing source, commands, JSON payloads or tool arguments. Highlight with Shiki using its css-variables theme. | `.m-code-frame` `.m-code-header` `.m-code-lang` `.m-prose pre / .m-prose code` |
| Keyboard key (`kbd`) | A key or key combination, drawn as a keycap. | Documenting shortcuts (Ctrl + K) in help text, menus and tooltips. | `.m-kbd` |
| Prose (`prose`) | Typography for rendered markdown and long-form text: headings, lists, quotes, code, tables and images, with no classes on the children. | Rendering markdown (docs, assistant replies, articles) or any HTML you do not control. | `.m-prose` `[data-size]` |

## AI patterns

| Component | What it is | Use it when | Markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chat (`chat`) | A conversation thread of messages from the user, the assistant, the system and tools, with a streaming caret. | Any assistant or agent conversation. Put markdown replies in .m-prose inside the message body (data-size="sm" for a compact thread). | `.m-chat` `.m-chat[data-variant]` `.m-message` `.m-message[data-role]` `.m-message-avatar` `.m-message-body` `.m-message-meta` `.m-message-actions` |
| Citation (`citation`) | Inline numbered chips that link a claim to its source, and a list of sources with title, domain and snippet. | Grounded answers (RAG, web search) where each claim should point to where it came from. | `.m-citation-source` `.m-citation-title` `.m-citation-domain` `.m-citation-snippet` |
| Prompt composer (`composer`) | The message input of a chat: an auto-growing textarea with an actions row for attachments, model choice and send. | The input at the bottom of an assistant conversation, or any prompt box. | `.m-composer-input` `.m-composer-actions` `.m-composer-model` `.m-composer-spacer` `[data-state="streaming"]` |
| Thinking (`thinking`) | A collapsible block for a model's reasoning, de-emphasised so the answer stays the focus. | Showing extended thinking or chain-of-thought summaries above an assistant reply. | `.m-thinking-label` `.m-thinking-duration` `.m-thinking-body` `[data-state="running"]` |
| Tool call (`tool-call`) | A collapsible record of one tool invocation: name, status, duration, arguments and result. | Showing what an agent did between messages (search, code execution, API calls). | `[data-status]` `.m-tool-call-name` `.m-tool-call-status` `.m-tool-call-duration` `.m-tool-call-body` `.m-tool-call-label` |
| Usage meter (`usage`) | Token or cost usage against a budget: a label row, a bar and a footer, coloured by how close the budget is. | Showing token budgets, context-window fill, credits or spend against a limit. | `.m-usage` `[data-level]` `.m-usage-header` `.m-usage-label` `.m-usage-amount` `.m-usage-bar` `.m-usage-footer` |
